goals: Verify the accessibility and expected content of the ESGF Thredds catalog.
Verify the ESGF Thredds File Server correctly serves CMIP5 and CMIP6 NetCDF files with appropriate content types.
activities: Send a GET request to the THREDDS catalog and verify the presence of 'Earth System Root catalog' in the response.
Send a HEAD request to a specific CMIP6 NetCDF file and verify its 'Content-Type' header.
Send a GET request to a specific CMIP6 historical NetCDF file and verify its 'Content-Type' header.
Send a GET request to a specific CMIP6 ScenarioMIP NetCDF file and verify its 'Content-Type' header.
Send a GET request to a specific CMIP5 land data NetCDF file and verify the response status.
Send a GET request to a specific CMIP5 ocean data NetCDF file and verify the response status.
